bijection_proof.encoding: Extract token-level last-exit arborescence plus the order of remaining outgoing tokens at each packet.
bijection_proof.injectivity: The queue algorithm deterministically reconstructs the unique labeled history from the extracted datum.
bijection_proof.no_early_root_stop: If it stops at r with unused tokens, the residual table is balanced everywhere. Any packet with residual outgoing still has its last-position tree token unused; that gives residual incoming to its parent, balance gives residual outgoing there, and iteration along the arborescence forces residual outgoing at r, contradicting an exhausted root queue.
bijection_proof.no_wrong_endpoint: If the queue walk stopped at v!=r with residual OUT(v)=0, subtracting partial endpoint incidence from full Stage-C balance forces residual OUT(v)-IN(v)=1, impossible.
bijection_proof.reconstruction_algorithm: For non-root x, queue its recorded non-tree outgoing tokens followed by a_x; root queue is its recorded full order. Start at s and repeatedly consume the first unused outgoing token in the current packet queue.
bijection_proof.surjectivity: Hence every admissible arborescence plus local-order datum consumes all tokens and ends at r.

local_order_encoding.non_root: Designated last-exit token a_x is fixed last; the other d_x-1 outgoing tokens have (d_x-1)! local orders.
local_order_encoding.root: No designated last exit; all d_r outgoing tokens have d_r! local orders.

unified_formula: |LABELED_FIBER(T;s,t)| = TAU_r(T) * d_r! * product_{x in A, x!=r} (d_x-1)!
